name: Quick LLMS txt
author: TechBeeps Services

sections.description:
The LLMS.txt Generator plugin creates a standardized llms.txt file that provides structured information about your WordPress website in a format optimized for AI and language models.

Key features:

  • Dual Generation Modes:

    • Automatic: Generates content based on your site structure
    • Manual: Full control over the file’s content

  • Comprehensive Content Coverage:

    • Posts, pages, and custom post types
    • Categories, tags, and custom taxonomies
    • Site information and technical details
    • (Automatically excludes shipping classes and floating elements)

  • Modern Admin Interface:

    • Clean, intuitive settings panel
    • Real-time preview of generated content
    • Responsive design
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/qkllmstxt-txt-generator directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > LLMS.txt Generator to configure
  4. Your llms.txt file will be automatically generated at yoursite.com/llms.txt
sections.faq:
What is an llms.txt file?

An llms.txt file is a standardized text file that provides structured information about your website specifically designed for consumption by AI systems and language models.

Can I exclude certain content?

Yes! The plugin automatically excludes:
– WooCommerce shipping classes
– Floating elements
– Other non-content post types

You can also manually control what gets included through the settings.

Where can I see my llms.txt file?

After saving your settings, visit yoursite.com/llms.txt to view the generated file.
